findings.title: Command is not executable
findings.cause: container web runs /scripts/run.sh from ConfigMap scripts, whose files have mode 0644 (defaultMode), so it is not executable; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: failed to create containerd task: failed to create shim task: OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: unable to start container process: error during container init: exec: "/scripts/run.sh": permission denied

evidence.what: container web mounts volume scripts (ConfigMap scripts) at /scripts

findings.fix: Set defaultMode: 0755 on volume scripts (or mode: 0755 on its item), or run the script through its interpreter, for example command: ["sh", "/scripts/run.sh"].
